node.title: F-primitive = j-fold concurrency of the evaluation-hyperplane arrangement (exact reformulation)
node.statement: On an r-flat P of parameter space, member-at-t has root x iff t lies on the hyperplane H_x = {P(x) = 0}. P cap D_j corresponds EXACTLY (up to the leading-coefficient hyperplane) to points lying on >= j of the n evaluation hyperplanes {H_x : x in H}. F-primitive <=> poly bound on j-fold concurrency points, with tangent shape = flats near {multiples of l_S} and periodic shape = pullback flats.
node.notes: turns F into finite-field incidence geometry: concurrency loci of a Vandermonde-type arrangement — a searchable literature (multiplicity incidence bounds, Furstenberg-type sets) | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 3): PROVABLE -> PROVED.
